title: Urgent contact

composition.entry: Official assistance precedes authorized private contact attempts
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to urgent contact; a resource provides urgent contact options
composition.priority: Failed notifications never count as acknowledged alerts

imagery.role: Support the actual urgent contact context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep official assistance accessible above changing call states
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the urgent contact structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no urgent contact content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Failed notifications never count as acknowledged alerts
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized urgent contact content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Failed notifications never count as acknowledged alerts
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active urgent contact context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
